punchline: He studied literature and biology, then chose medicine because moral speculation seemed puny next to moral action.
thirty_sec: Paul Kalanithi grew up in Kingman, Arizona, studied English literature and human biology at Stanford, then at Cambridge decided that questions about life and death needed direct experience, and went to Yale School of Medicine.
question: Which question could you go and watch being decided, in person, this month?
key_contrast: He moved from discussing life-and-death questions to standing where they are decided.
